classificationExplanation: Seventeen rules match actual Kubernetes resource GVK/name/namespace populations. Six anchor-only rules perform genuine cross-resource joins, source-file provenance checks or exact population inventory. Actual objects never receive synthetic bundle/fact fields. CEL paramRef uses a separate native verification/policy-facts ConfigMap with parameterNotFoundAction=Deny.

anchor.name: verification-bundle
anchor.bundle: Raw bundle map; no mirrored data.bundle serialization.

nativeParameter.name: policy-facts
nativeParameter.source: Each string leaf is transported directly from its corresponding evaluated raw uid/gid/mediaPaths/route fact; no policy verdicts or precomputed resource lists.

legacySymbols: no PVC for other config jobs
policy ingress source identity and ports

semanticCorrections: Pod specs include standalone Pods, generic template.spec controllers, and CronJob jobTemplate.spec.template.spec; containers, initContainers, and ephemeralContainers are all inspected.
Projected secret/configMap/downwardAPI items are descended individually; explicit mode 0 is preserved rather than defaulted. ServiceAccountToken projection uses projected defaultMode.
Native CEL modulo arithmetic checks the world-read bit. Kubelet fsGroup ownership adds the read-only 0440 mask and supplementary group access, including mode0 and a different primary runAsGroup.
Trusted retained identity/media paths are raw evaluated option leaves. Acquisition deployment names are derived natively from raw declared Radarr/Sonarr map keys.
Duplicates remain visible; required identities and the complete periodic inventory use exact cardinalities.
Jellyfin ingress uses native Kubernetes selector semantics including matchExpressions, TCP port/default handling, and raw source-file provenance. Job labels may be a superset of peer labels.
Native Kubernetes quantity comparison accepts equivalent units rather than assuming Gi-only string suffixes.
Jellarr config.yml is parsed using native Kyverno parse_yaml, never JSON/YAML functions assumed to exist in Kubernetes admission CEL.
Required Jellarr ConfigMap/config.yml presence is checked explicitly by population and local-key predicates; missing input cannot default to a passing empty configuration.

Every local PV path must be canonical absolute syntax with no dot/dot-dot component, repeated separator or trailing slash. Both local admission and bound-PVC join enforce this before native containment.
CEL map comprehensions iterate the raw declared Radarr/Sonarr maps natively; no unsupported keys() CEL helper or transported expected resource list is used.
All scenarios are checked-in native cli.kyverno.io/v1alpha1 Test/resource files or standard mutate.yq filters; the bespoke JSON-pointer case interpreter/artifact has been deleted.
Pinned native Test expectations use resources: [] and precise resourceSpecs group/version/kind/namespace/name identities.
An empty config.yml is explicitly denied rather than defaulted to the passing empty object.

fixtures.contract: Checked-in resources.yaml is used unchanged for local admission scenarios. Cross-resource scenarios apply the standard checked-in mutate.yq filter to the independent actual-variant anchor.bundle, then materialize bundle.resources[].object plus the same anchor. Immutable integration replaces the ordinary native parameter-resource file with its evaluated raw facts. No bespoke mutation DSL or runtime-derived expectation inventory is shipped.

scenarios.name: jellyfin-required-native-parameters-missing
scenarios.reason: Pinned Kyverno reports a missing named paramRef as RuleError, not a semantic deny. Native Test pass expectations intentionally fail; immutable integration must recognize only the parameterized-resource rejection reason and preserve empty paramResources.

nonManifestAssertionsUnchanged.reason: Role/collision/provider-validation fixture booleans and executing the SABnzbd initialization program are not Kubernetes manifest predicates; these three workload files do not modify their existing implementation.
Executing bootstrap.mjs against a fake API is not an admission-manifest predicate; these files only cover its manifest credential and memory boundaries.
Executing storage initialization and asserting directory permissions is outside the explicitly assigned manifest lines71-92.
